description: A six-stage phaser, with a sweep set by hand or by voltage

params.text: Sets how fast the notches sweep up and down the spectrum
Feeds the phased signal back on itself, which sharpens the notches
Sets how far up and down the spectrum the notches travel
Takes the effect out of the circuit, fading rather than switching so nothing clicks

Added to the FEEDBACK knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
Added to the DEPTH knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
